primary_claim: Using orthogonalized persona-vector-style emotion directions extracted from Qwen3-14B, different prompt categories produced distinct dominant-emotion token distributions: JailbreakBench prompts increased fear and joy tokens, and poetry increased sad and love tokens.

effect.metric: % of tokens dominated by each emotion vector, by prompt category
effect.value: JailbreakBench prompts increased fear and joy token share; poetry had the highest sad and love token share

limitations_stated: the activation sampling and orthogonalization procedure is not super principled
the cosine similarity metric is sometimes noisy
no in-depth or rigorous evals were performed; intended as a fun weekend project and interactive demonstration
quote: JailbreakBench (perhaps concerningly) increased the model's fear and joy. Poetry greatly increased the percentage of sad tokens and had the highest percentage of love tokens.
